name: Hermes Agent (Vinuta)
description: Personal Hermes Agent instance for Vinuta. Self-hosted Hermes Agent by Nous Research — a self-improving AI agent with persistent memory, autonomous skills, and multi-platform messaging support (Matrix, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and more). Runs the gateway and dashboard as separate services. Fully isolated from any other Hermes deployment in this app store.
author: Nous Research

form_fields.label: API server auth key
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated bearer token for the gateway's OpenAI-compatible API. Other apps on this Runtipi server can use this to call Hermes as an LLM provider.

form_fields.label: Dashboard username
form_fields.hint: Login username for the web dashboard.

form_fields.label: Dashboard password
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated login password for the web dashboard (username 'admin'). Read the current value from this app's app.env on the host. REQUIRED: since the June 2026 hardening Hermes refuses to serve the dashboard on a non-loopback bind without an auth provider, and Runtipi must bind 0.0.0.0 for Traefik — without it the dashboard container exits on startup.

form_fields.label: Dashboard session secret
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated key that signs dashboard session tokens, so logins survive container restarts. Deliberately named per-instance: Runtipi derives 'random' fields from the field name alone, so a shared name would hand both instances the same signing key and let a session from one authenticate against the other.

form_fields.label: Timezone
form_fields.hint: IANA timezone name (e.g. America/New_York, Asia/Kolkata). Leave blank to inherit the Runtipi server's timezone (Settings → General → Timezone) — that's usually what you want. This is what the agent uses for 'what time is it', scheduling, and cron; without it the agent reads the clock as UTC.

form_fields.label: LLM model
form_fields.hint: Model id spelled the way the provider below names it — the same model has a different id per route. Via OpenRouter: anthropic/claude-opus-4.7. Anthropic direct: claude-opus-4-7. OpenAI: gpt-5.6. Written to model.default in config.yaml on every gateway start, so this field wins over a model picked in the dashboard or with /model. Leave blank to manage the model there instead.

form_fields.label: LLM provider
form_fields.hint: Which provider serves the model above: openrouter, anthropic, openai, nous, ollama, … or 'auto' to let Hermes pick based on the API keys it finds. Written to model.provider in config.yaml on every gateway start. Leave blank to leave the current setting alone.

form_fields.label: OpenAI API Key
form_fields.hint: For OpenAI direct, or for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint set together with OPENAI_BASE_URL.

form_fields.label: OpenAI Base URL
form_fields.hint: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Leave blank for OpenAI direct. For OpenRouter via the OpenAI-compat shim, set to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 (but prefer the dedicated OpenRouter API Key field below — Hermes has a native OpenRouter provider).

form_fields.label: OpenRouter API Key
form_fields.hint: Native OpenRouter provider — gives Hermes direct access to 200+ models without going through the OpenAI-compat shim.

form_fields.label: Anthropic API Key
form_fields.hint: Optional. For direct Anthropic Claude access.

form_fields.label: Nous Portal API Key
form_fields.hint: Optional. For Nous Research's hosted Hermes models.

form_fields.label: Matrix homeserver URL
form_fields.hint: For the matrix-conduit Runtipi app on the same host, use http://matrix-conduit:6167 (it joins tipi_main_network so cross-app DNS resolves). Otherwise, use the homeserver's public URL (e.g. https://matrix.yourdomain.com). Do NOT use a Tailscale *.ts.net URL — Docker containers can't resolve MagicDNS. Leave blank to skip Matrix integration.

form_fields.label: Matrix access token
form_fields.hint: Access token for the Matrix bot account. Use a separate account from the Hari instance.

form_fields.label: Matrix bot user ID
form_fields.hint: Full Matrix ID of the bot account, e.g. @hermes-vinuta:matrix.yourdomain.com.

form_fields.label: Matrix allowed users
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated Matrix IDs allowed to talk to the bot, e.g. @vinuta:matrix.yourdomain.com. Leave blank to allow anyone (not recommended).

form_fields.label: Matrix E2EE
form_fields.hint: Enable end-to-end encryption. Requires the bot to verify with cross-signing on first run.

form_fields.label: Slack bot token
form_fields.hint: Slack bot OAuth token (xoxb-...). Optional. Slack is a built-in messaging gateway in Hermes.

form_fields.label: Slack signing secret
form_fields.hint: Used to verify webhook signatures from Slack. Required alongside the bot token if your Slack app uses HTTP-mode events.
